I never loved, but loved alone,
I never sang but out of tune,
I never wrote, but what was wrong,

It was a significant blow when my mother, who was the only one in my family to support my passion for filmmaking, passed away. At that time, I was left with a void that I could not fill, and I found myself lost and without direction. However, I eventually found the strength to continue pursuing my dreams, and I dedicated my work to her memory.
